rs.innovation_approach: 跨18域182384条交错文本/生成图像轨迹，以原生图像生成SFT种视觉思考行为。
rs.key_step: 程序渲染/模拟加Gemini丰富逻辑，Bagel补vision-start loss让模型能自主切换生成图像。
rs.why_non_obvious: 视觉起始token未训练会使原有双模态模型不能原生交错生成。
rs.trigger_condition: When a unified model cannot emit interleaved visual traces, supervise modality-switch tokens and coherent visual examples.
rs.abstract_strategy: 先补行为接口再谈RL优化。
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When desired actions are outside learned support, expose them in supervised traces.
